Module-level cross-product facade imports in API modules are the repo norm, and the CLAUDE.md rule pushes the other way from the suggestion. The INSTALLED_APPS-removal scenario has no reachable trigger: stamphog_connected is a deliberate cross-product feature of this PR, and the only realistic failure (stamphog DB read) is already caught.
